messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT — decode nodes in eu-west-1 reporting repeated CUDA OOMs during streaming decode. Multiple container restarts observed. Paging on-call SREs now.

sam: seeing a burst of streaming requests with huge max_tokens values — looks like some clients sent malformed prompts. requests/spike ~x8.

nina: confirmed, logs show a bunch of requests with max_tokens=100000 in the wild. that will blow the decode KV cache and trigger OOM cascading. sample log: 
```
2026-03-15T09:42:13Z ERR container-12345: CUDA error: out of memory while allocating 345678901 bytes
Request: {"model":"redwood-v1-stream","user_id":"acct-42","max_tokens":100000,"prompt_len":512}
```

liz: oncall here, i took the pager. i'm going to mute the eu-west streaming queue for new sessions while we triage. can someone quantify customer impact first?

marc: running a quick query against the proxy metrics. ops-bot, can you pull request drop counts and active sessions per customer in the last 10m?

ops-bot: query run: `SELECT customer_id, dropped_requests, active_streams FROM streaming_metrics WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes';`
Result (top 3):
- cust-omega: dropped 122 requests, active_streams 8
- cust-pico: dropped 45 requests, active_streams 3
- cust-lab: dropped 12 requests, active_streams 1
Total dropped in window: 189

sam: thanks. that matches traces — customers on long-running generation sessions hit node restarts and lost the live stream. we need an immediate mitigation: enforce an upper bound on max_tokens and route oversized reqs to a secondary, smaller-model pool.

nina: can we hotpatch the request-filter in the edge proxy to cap max_tokens to 2048 and return 413-like error for anything bigger? that should stop the runaway allocations fast.

liz: do it. marc, if you can flip that proxy rule, i'll keep eu-west queue limited to existing connections only.

marc: applying proxy hotpatch now. patch: `edge-proxy: add request_limit: if max_tokens > 2048 then reject`
`kubectl -n edge set-config edge-proxy --patch '{"request_limit":{"max_tokens":2048}}'`

ops-bot: deploying config -> rollout started across edge-proxy (eu-west-1). rolling restart of 3 pods.

sam: while rollout runs, let's also enable model-fallback routing in the router for streaming decode to route to smaller-memory model variant (redwood-v1-lite) when host memory pressure > 70%. config snippet: 
```
router.policy = {
  throttle_by_memory: true,
  mem_threshold_pct: 70,
  fallback_model: "redwood-v1-lite"
}
```

nina: i've enabled fallback policy on staging; enabling on prod now. note: redwood-v1-lite has slightly different tokenizer, but better than dropping the request.

ops-bot: fallback policy flip -> applied to eu-west cluster; router logs show a drop in OOM events post-fallback.

liz: update on impact: dropped requests in last 3 minutes reduced from 189 -> 22. customer visible errors should be mostly the rejects for >2048 tokens and some routed to lite model.

marc: digging into root cause — looks like a client-side bug in a partner integration that sent an unbounded max_tokens when an optional field was null. i'll reach out to partner contact. also creating a short-lived WAF rule to block that partner's token until they patch.

sam: next actions: 1) keep proxy cap until we roll a longer-term request validation and telemetry change; 2) add a preflight validator that normalizes missing max_tokens to a safe default; 3) backfill metrics to identify any other partners hitting this.

nina: i'll own the preflight validator RFC and a PR for the SDK default. aiming for PR today, rollout tomorrow.

liz: coordinating handoff: i'll be on-call for another 20 mins to confirm stability, then handing to marc for overnight watch. marc, take it from me in 20.

marc: got it. i'll keep an eye; setting alert to page if OOM rate > 5/min or if dropped_requests spikes > 50/min.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created INC-2026-042: "eu-west streaming decode OOMs due to oversized max_tokens" with severity P1. responders: liz (primary), marc (secondary).

sam: small follow-up: we should add a unit test in the proxy integration tests that simulates insane max_tokens and ensures reject/cap behavior. tagging infra-qos. :thumbsup:

nina: noted. creating ticket in infra backlog now.

ops-bot: postmortem checklist created and linked to the incident. please add timelines and customer impact summaries.

liz: closing the active P1 mitigation loop: proxy cap + fallback model + temporary WAF + partner outreach. monitoring for 30m, if stable we'll post incident update to customers. nice work team. :sparkles:
